collectible.title: Magma Hoodie
collectible.subtitle: "Wait, how come they get to keep MY hoodie? That's a stupid rule!"
collectible.text:
Joining Team Magma comes with its own uniform! One free hoodie per grunt. Do not lose the hoodie, or you'll have to pay out of pocket.
Wear this hoodie to see her butt poses more frequently during a game, including a unique bonus pose.
collectible.unlock: Finish a game where the Team Magma Grunt loses.

collectible.title: One-Finger Challenge Selfie
collectible.subtitle: "Hmm, kinda showin off my nips a bit, I'd better- No, don't send!"
collectible.text:
She accidentally hit send before she could line it up perfectly.
If you ever want to reset your progress with her, name yourself 'Trainer'.
collectible.unlock: Get the Team Magma Grunt to warm up to you over the course of multiple games. (Finish 3 games against her, win or lose.)

collectible.title: Maggie's Sweet Hearts
collectible.text: A piece of cloyingly sweet chocolate. When consumed, it restores 20 HP to an injured Pokémon.
collectible.unlock: Finish a game with the Team Magma Grunt in her "Casual Date" outfit (available during the Valentine's Day event).
